instruction.text: Read each paragraph about body parts. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: We use our noses to recognise smells. Sometimes they are good smells, and sometimes they are bad smells. Which do you prefer?
This body part can be found on the lower half of our bodies. We use them to the able to walk and run.
We use this body part to hear different noises. When people’s ears don’t work on their own, they are given a hearing aid. This helps them to hear better.

instruction.text: Read each paragraph. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: This king is famous for having six wives and killing two of them. He reigned over England for almost 40 years.
These animals are the largest raptors on Earth. They have around 70 teeth and eat a diet mostly consisting of fish.
This is a beautiful island that is part of the USA. Many people go on holiday there because of its amazing beaches.
This language is spoken in Spain and most countries in South America. It is taught as a subject in many schools.

instruction.text: Read each paragraph. Select the best subheading for each paragraph.

atoms.a: Many people nowadays drive a car because it is the most convenient way to travel. However, you can also travel by bus or train. The healthiest way to travel is by riding a bike.
Doctors need to train for many years to become qualified. Their job is to find out what is wrong with you when you’re ill. It is a well-respected job.
Our bodies are made up of 70% water. It is important to keep hydrated throughout the day. This becomes even more important when the weather is hot.
Human beings first walked on the moon in 1969. People have continued to go there ever since. A full astronaut suit can cost over 10 million pounds.
